post_title: What will Argentina's country risk (riesgo país, JP Morgan EMBI+) be at the close on October 29, 2026?

question.title: What will Argentina's country risk (riesgo país, JP Morgan EMBI+) be at the close on October 29, 2026?
question.description:
Argentina's "riesgo país" (country risk) is the EMBI+ Argentina sovereign-debt spread computed daily by JP Morgan. It measures the extra yield, in basis points, that investors demand to hold Argentine sovereign dollar bonds over comparable US Treasuries; a higher value signals less confidence in Argentina's ability to repay its debt. The figure is reported daily by Argentine financial media including Infobae, Ámbito Financiero and Perfil.

During 2026 the index has been volatile. It tightened to roughly 498 basis points on May 12, 2026 amid optimism about a return to capital markets, and dipped to around 473 bp in mid-August. It then climbed, reaching a 2026 high near 650–655 bp in early October 2026 (around 636 bp on October 1). It eased to about 573 bp on October 6 after Brazil's first-round election result was read as favorable, then rose again, trading roughly 620–641 bp in mid-October (641 bp as of October 15, up about 8.8% over five days).

Key drivers of near-term movement include Argentina's budget and fiscal negotiations, debate over the peso's exchange-rate band, global risk sentiment, and the Brazilian presidential runoff scheduled for October 25, 2026. This question asks where the index will settle at the close of October 29, 2026.

question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves to the closing value, in basis points, of Argentina's country-risk index (riesgo país) for the trading day of October 29, 2026, as reported by Infobae's live indicator page: https://www.infobae.com/economia/indicador/riesgo-pais/ . The riesgo país is the EMBI+ Argentina spread calculated daily by JP Morgan, expressed in basis points (e.g., a reading of 641 basis points resolves as 641). The relevant figure is the value displayed for the close of October 29, 2026 (the end-of-day figure for that Argentine trading day).
question.fine_print: If Infobae no longer displays the figure, the closing riesgo país value for October 29, 2026 as reported by [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) (such as Ámbito Financiero or Perfil, reporting the JP Morgan EMBI+ Argentina spread) will be used. If October 29, 2026 turns out not to be a trading day for Argentine sovereign bonds, the closing value for the first Argentine bond-trading day after October 29, 2026 applies.
